{{Enemy description|The "Varykentron Anavon" (archive ID: ARL141α) is an energized variant of ARL141 that has retained a plethora of attack patterns. It is a tougher and more dangerous entity.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Heavy Sting]], Heavy Stings α have similar appearance with their counterpart, but it doesn't make them less of the threat with most abilities remained:

*Fires one shot from their tail, dealing Physical damage.
*Fires three consecutive shots from their tail, dealing Physical damage.
*Thrusts their tail into the ground, and erupts three areas around, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back.
*Thrusts their tail into the ground, and erupts the ground below an Operator for three times, dealing Physical damage and knock them back. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
